description: This file defines the `LoanInstallmentCharge` class, representing charges associated with a loan installment within a loan management system. It includes fields for amounts, statuses, and relationships to other domain entities such as `LoanCharge` and `LoanRepaymentScheduleInstallment`. The class provides methods for calculating outstanding amounts, managing payments, waivers, and converting to a data transfer object.

classes.name: LoanInstallmentCharge
classes.description: Entity representing a charge applied to a specific loan installment, including amount calculations, payment status, waivers, and relations to other loan domain entities.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this charge to another based on installment number.

methods.name: copyFrom
methods.description: Copies data from another LoanInstallmentCharge instance.

methods.name: waive
methods.description: Marks the charge as waived, setting outstanding amount to zero.

methods.name: undoWaive
methods.description: Reverts a waive action, restoring previous outstanding amount.

methods.name: getAmountWaived
methods.description: Returns the amount waived as a Money object in the given currency.

methods.name: getAmountOutstanding
methods.description: Returns the amount outstanding as a Money object.

methods.name: determineIfFullyPaid
methods.description: Checks if the charge is fully paid based on amounts.

methods.name: undoWaive
methods.description: Overloaded; restores outstanding and waived amounts.

methods.name: calculateOutstanding
methods.description: Calculates current outstanding amount considering paid, waived, and written-off amounts.

methods.name: getAmount
methods.description: Returns the total amount as a Money object.

methods.name: getAmountPaid
methods.description: Returns the amount paid as a Money object.

methods.name: calculateAmountOutstanding
methods.description: Calculates amount outstanding based on currency, amount paid, waived, and written-off.

methods.name: isPending
methods.description: Checks if the outstanding amount is non-zero.

methods.name: isChargeAmountpaid
methods.description: Verifies if the amount paid through charge payment matches the amount paid.

methods.name: getRepaymentInstallment
methods.description: Returns the associated repayment schedule installment.

methods.name: updatePaidAmountBy
methods.description: Updates the amount paid on the charge, adjusting outstanding and payment flags.

methods.name: getAmountWrittenOff
methods.description: Returns the amount written off as a Money object.

methods.name: resetPaidAmount
methods.description: Resets paid and outstanding amounts to initial state.

methods.name: undoWaiveFlag
methods.description: Removes waive status flag.

methods.name: setOutstandingAmount
methods.description: Sets the current outstanding amount.

methods.name: resetToOriginal
methods.description: Resets all amounts and flags to the original state.

methods.name: getAmountThroughChargePayment
methods.description: Returns the amount through charge payment as Money.

methods.name: getUnpaidAmountThroughChargePayment
methods.description: Returns remaining unpaid amount through charge payment.

methods.name: updateAmountThroughChargePayment
methods.description: Ensures the amount through charge payment does not exceed total amount.

methods.name: updateWaivedAmount
methods.description: Updates waived amount considering current state.

methods.name: updateInstallment
methods.description: Updates the associated installment.

methods.name: undoPaidAmountBy
methods.description: Reverses a payment made, adjusting paid and outstanding amounts.

methods.name: getLoanCharge
methods.description: Returns the associated LoanCharge entity.

methods.name: toData
methods.description: Converts the entity to a data transfer object for external use.
